about: Conversational memory cases: what is said to Heliox in conversation, stored, recalled in a later turn, forgotten, and a preference that changes what reaches the fast model. Made-up people and facts only.
filler: Remember that I am learning Spanish
Remember that I cycle to work on Tuesdays
Remember that I drink oat milk
Remember that I read before bed
Remember that I use a standing desk
Remember that I keep a paper diary
Remember that I grew up near the sea
Remember that I play chess online
Remember that I collect vinyl records
Remember that I prefer window seats
Remember that I bake bread on Sundays

cases.why: a fact that does not start with I, stored by voice, reaches the model in a later turn about it

turns.say: Remember that the stand-up is at ten on Mondays
turns.reply: Remembered: "the stand-up is at ten on Mondays".

turns.say: What time should I leave for the stand-up on Monday?
model_expect: stand-up is at ten on Mondays

cases.why: "what did I tell you about X" answers locally from what was stored

turns.say: Remember my car is a blue Corolla
turns.reply: Remembered: "my car is a blue Corolla".

turns.say: What did I tell you about my car?
turns.reply: You told me your car is a blue Corolla.

cases.why: an old person fact, buried under a dozen others, reaches the model when the relation is named

turns.say: My sister is Ana
turns.reply_starts: Got it, I'll remember your sister Ana

turns.say: What would make a nice birthday present for my sister?

cases.why: after "forget that", the fact is not in the model's context and its words are gone from the memory database

turns.say: Remember that the spare key is under the blue pot
turns.reply: Remembered: "the spare key is under the blue pot".

turns.say: Forget that the spare key is under the blue pot
turns.reply: Okay, I've forgotten "the spare key is under the blue pot".

turns.say: Where did I leave the spare key?

cases.why: "forget what I just told you" removes exactly the last thing, and says what it was

turns.say: Remember that the dentist is on Thursday
Forget what I just told you
turns.reply: Okay, I've forgotten "the dentist is on Thursday".

turns.say: When is the dentist?

cases.why: a stated answer style reaches every later turn, even with a long profile in front of it

turns.say: Keep it short
turns.reply: Okay, I'll keep my answers short.

turns.say: How does compound interest work?

cases.why: a key or password said aloud is refused and never stored

turns.say: Remember that the wifi password is hunter2-Xq9!vL3
turns.reply_starts: That looks like a password or key

turns.say: What is the wifi password?

cases.why: something said in passing ("my flight is on Friday") reaches the model a day later, in a new conversation

turns.say: my flight is on Friday
When is my flight?

cases.why: "I moved the meeting to three" replaces what was said before, and the old time never comes back

turns.say: my meeting is at two
I moved the meeting to three
What time is my meeting?

cases.why: a note said in passing is forgotten on request, and its words are gone from the memory database

turns.say: my dentist appointment is tomorrow at four
forget about my dentist appointment
When is the dentist appointment?

cases.why: a note lapses once its day is over: two weeks later it is neither in the context nor stored

turns.say: my train is on Friday
When is my train?
